snippet.title: Bases Loaded (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Jaleco, Jul 1988 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Bases Loaded was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in July 1988. All audio/visual elements copyright 1988, Jaleco. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/bases-loaded/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT BASES LOADED (NES)

Bases Loaded featured a unique television-style depiction of the pitcher-batter matchup, as well as strong play control and a relatively high degree of realism, which made it one of the most popular baseball games of the early NES era. One unique feature of the game is that the pitcher can provoke a batter to charge the mound. Each team has only one batter who can be provoked in this manner, however (usually the team's best hitter); it is up to the player to discover who it is. At the time Bases Loaded was released, few video games were licensed by major league sports. Therefore, the league depicted in Bases Loaded is a fictitious league of 12 teams.

AKA: Moero!! Pro Yakyuu
